meta_description: The Tayug Family Hospital Run 2026: December 6 in Tayug, Pangasinan. 21K, 10K, and 5K from JCIR Events — a provincial Philippine charity run.
dek: Set for 6 December 2026 in Tayug, Pangasinan, this JCIR Events-organised run offers three distances. Registration isn't open yet. A provincial Philippine charity road race in the heart of the Ilocos region.
verdict: The Tayug Family Hospital Run is a provincial Philippine charity race organised by JCIR Events in Tayug, Pangasinan — a municipality in the Ilocos region roughly 200km north of Manila. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K) and a hospital-charity framing give it community purpose. Registration isn't open yet and the reliability score is low, so it's one for local runners to track rather than travellers to book. The December date in Pangasinan is dry-season, with comfortable morning conditions.
